name: College of Mysteria
source:
The adventures of Will and Cindy. The duo find themselves plunged into a world they could have only dreamt of. Juggle a life of study, debauchery and a smidge of saving the world.

[From F95Zone]
translation:
威尔和辛迪的冒险。两人发现自己陷入了一个他们只能梦想的世界。兼顾学习、放荡和拯救世界的生活。

[来自F95Zone]
